note: Experiment det A/B: mono 1ch dets with the SAME product I/O recipe (uint8 analytic → fp16/fp32 mid → uint8 heat). They differ by architecture/weights, not by feed path.
apk_packaging: Scheduled nbs live in ABI flavor trees (app/src/arm64|x86_64/assets/paddle/exp_det_ab/). Unscheduled: third_party/paddle/exp_det_ab_unscheduled/.

pipeline.v5_pir_to_classic: Paddle 3.x paddle2onnx (inference.json+pdiparams) → onnxsim (server BN fold) → Paddle 2.6 x2paddle dynamic [-1,3,-1,-1] → classic inference.pdmodel/pdiparams under research/models/det_ab_classic_from_pir/
pipeline.mono: convert_mono mean first-conv RGB→1ch; feed shape [-1,1,-1,-1] → det_ab_mono_product/
pipeline.armv8_server: --valid_targets=arm --enable_fp16=false → uint8_to_fp32 mid + fp32_to_uint8 heat (REQUIRED on phone; fp16 mid → all-zero heatmaps)
pipeline.server_phone_limits: 2026-08-10 probe: server arm fp16 mid = zero heat at all safe sides; server arm fp32 mid = non-zero heat for side≤640; side≳640 SIGSEGV (NX memory) on both precisions. Cap phone server tile/side ≤640. Host x86 was always fp32 mid so host multi-scale looked fine.
pipeline.server_reopt: 2026-08-09 max1024 re-opt for v4 after phone SIGSEGV (did not fix zeros or ≥640 SEGV); 2026-08-10 arm server re-opt with enable_fp16=false restores heat ≤640

PP-OCRv4_server_det.feed: 1,1,H,W uint8 mono (phone tile/side ≤640; multi-scale host canvas may be 2048/4096)
PP-OCRv4_server_det.arm_mid: fp32 (do not enable_fp16 for server on phone)

PP-OCRv5_mobile_det.source: det_ab_src PIR → paddle2onnx → x2paddle@paddle2.6 → mono → product opt (2026-08-10)
PP-OCRv5_mobile_det.note: Converted from official inference.json (PIR). Not a product_det stand-in.

PP-OCRv5_server_det.source: det_ab_src PIR → paddle2onnx → onnxsim (BN fold) → x2paddle@paddle2.6 → mono → product opt (2026-08-10)
PP-OCRv5_server_det.arm_mid: fp32 (do not enable_fp16 for server on phone)
PP-OCRv5_server_det.note: Server needed onnxsim to fold BatchNorm (x2paddle BN op failed on raw export). onnxsim uses fixed 1x3x640x640 for fold only; mono keeps dynamic H/W. Phone: arm fp16 mid = zero heat; arm fp32 mid OK ≤640; SEGV above.

why_sizes_differ: File size tracks network capacity (more filters/layers/weights), not missing u8-fp16. first_conv_out_channels is only the width of the first layer — an architecture label, not a precision path.

precision.armv8_server: fp32 mid-graph on phone: uint8_to_fp32 + fp32_to_uint8 (fp16 mid broken for server)
